proposed.explanation: The available evidence contains ambiguous figures regarding revenues and net profits for the nine-month period ending September 30, 2026, and September 30, 2025, because the page shows multiple conflicting unit lines. While the basic earnings per share figures are verified at 8.74 EGP for the nine months ended September 30, 2026, and 4.28 EGP for the nine months ended September 30, 2025, it is not possible to reliably project full-year 2026 earnings per share or calculate an accurate price-to-earnings ratio without clear and unambiguous financial statements and revenue data. Therefore, there is insufficient evidence to determine whether the share is cheap enough to buy.
